title: GOTHAM GADGETS
oneLiner: Leap across Gotham rooftops, grab gadgets, and land every jump before the night closes in.
mechanics: Batman runs left and right across fixed rooftop platforms and jumps with A; hold A for a full 32-pixel jump, tap for a shorter hop, with a 0.10-second coyote window.
Collect batarangs, grapnels, and signal beacons for 100 points each; chain three gadgets without missing a landing for a capped 2x multiplier.
Rooftop gaps, low chimneys, and patrolling searchlight drones create readable hazards; use precise short or full jumps to choose safe or risky routes.
Every 20 seconds the camera reveals a new bounded rooftop chunk, alternating safe recovery platforms with optional high-value shortcuts; speed rises modestly to a 30-second danger peak.

controls.a: Jump; hold for a higher jump
controls.b: Use the grapnel to pull Batman toward a marked rooftop beacon once per jump

lose: Batman falls into a rooftop gap or collides with a searchlight drone three times; three hearts are shown.
scoring: Collect gadgets for 100 points, with a 2x multiplier after three consecutive collections; taking damage resets the chain.
